description.value: Single V Coffee is a specialty coffee roaster founded in 2019 in South Burnaby, focusing on single-origin beans sourced from Ethiopia, Colombia, and beyond with detailed processing notes for each lot. The roaster operates out of Kingsway Plaza and is accessible from the rear parking lot on Bennett Street. Cyclists can pick up freshly roasted beans or visit the cafe, which also supplies pour-over bars at partner venues in Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (1 space) at 64m; stands (3 spaces) at 87m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Single V Coffee is a real, operating specialty coffee roaster with a physical pickup location at 140-5000 Kingsway, Burnaby (Kingsway Plaza) — this differs from the OSM address of 5232 Irmin Street, so the website address is preferred per Rule 12. The FAQ and 'PICK UP' navigation confirm in-store pickup is available. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM lists 5232 Irmin Street, but the website contact page clearly states the location is 140-5000 Kingsway, Burnaby, BC (Kingsway Plaza), accessible from the rear parking lot on Bennett St. The website address has been used as it appears current and authoritative.
OSM opening hours (Mo-Fr 09:00-18:00; Sa-Su 10:00-18:00) differ from website hours (Mon-Fri 8:00-4:00 | Sat-Sun 10:00-4:00) — the website hours appear more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating specialty coffee roaster and cafe with a confirmed physical pickup location in Burnaby. Useful stop for cyclists seeking coffee and roasted beans.

Takeout.detail: Website has a dedicated 'PICK UP' navigation section; FAQ states 'In-store Pickup — Please wait for a confirmation text message or email before coming in to pick up your coffee.'

wow_evidence: specialty coffee roaster founded in 2019... single-origin beans sourced from Ethiopia, Colombia
